questions.q: What's the core difference between drill mode and drillthrough?
options: They are the same feature with two different names
Drillthrough only works in the Power BI service, never in Desktop
Drill mode only works on tables; drillthrough only works on charts
Drill mode moves through hierarchy levels within one visual; drillthrough navigates to an entirely different report page
questions.explain: Both go from summary to detail, but drill mode stays within one visual's hierarchy, while drillthrough takes you to a whole separate page filtered to your selection.

questions.q: How do you set up a drillthrough page?
options: Add the field to the Filters pane at the report level
Add a new page, drag a field into the Drillthrough filters well in the Visualizations pane, and add visuals for that filtered context
Right-click any visual and select New drillthrough page
Drillthrough pages are created automatically for every report
questions.explain: The Drillthrough filters well is what tells Power BI which field determines what the page is filtered to when a viewer navigates there.

questions.q: What happens automatically when you add a field to a drillthrough page's filter well?
options: The field is removed from every other visual in the report
Power BI adds a Back button to the page
All other pages in the report are hidden
The page is deleted from the report
questions.explain: The automatic Back button lets viewers return to wherever they navigated from, without you having to build that navigation yourself.

questions.q: Why might Drillthrough not appear in a visual's right-click context menu?
options: The report hasn't been published to the Power BI service yet
Drillthrough requires a Premium license to appear in Desktop
Drillthrough only works on the first page of a report
The drillthrough filter field isn't present, unaggregated, in the visual being right-clicked
questions.explain: The field used as the drillthrough filter must exist in the source visual, unaggregated, for the option to show up in that visual's context menu.

options: Both reports must be the exact same file
It works automatically with no configuration between any two reports
Only that both reports use the same theme colors
Both reports published to the same workspace, Cross-report drillthrough enabled in the target report, and matching field names/types
questions.explain: Cross-report drillthrough needs the source and target in the same workspace, the feature explicitly enabled in the target's settings, and consistent field names and data types.
